question_text: A 27-year-old woman goes to the genetic counseling clinic after having a child with Down syndrome. In the child, a trisomy 21 with translocation 21/21 inherited from the mother is identified. What would be the risk of recurrence of Down syndrome in the future children of this woman?

Question: A 27-year-old woman goes to the genetic counseling clinic after having a child with Down syndrome. In the child, a trisomy 21 with translocation 21/21 inherited from the mother is identified. What would be the risk of recurrence of Down syndrome in the future children of this woman?

Options:
opa. The risk of recurrence will be 10-15%, as in the rest of translocations.
opb. 100% of viable fetuses will be born with Down syndrome.
opc. The risk of recurrence will be very low (12%).
opd. The risk of recurrence will be 50%.

        Provide your response in valid JSON format:

        }
